svg.title: MyDesign datapath schematic
svg.desc: Register-level datapath of the self-attention accelerator: four SRAM read-address generators, operand muxes and registers, the integer multiply-accumulate, and the result and scratchpad write-back registers, with all mux select signals.
svg.text: All flip-flops: posedge clk, synchronous active-low reset_n. Q = the register's own output (hold / feedback). Red = control select from FSM (sheet 2). Thick = 32-bit data, thin = 16-bit address.
reset value 1 → DUT is ready after reset
C · Write-back registers (to Result and Scratchpad SRAMs)
Output ports keep their full names, e.g. dut__tb__sram_result_write_data; the “dut__tb__sram_” prefix is shortened to “→” above.
